puzzle.instruction: Track how the perimeter jump changes. Where does the token land next?
puzzle.explanation: Read the eight outside slots as one ordered ring. The token moves clockwise, starting with a jump of 2 slots; each later jump grows by 2. The next jump is therefore 10 slots in the same direction, which lands at the highlighted position. Each distractor comes from another bounded direction, starting jump, or growth rule that fails a shown landing.

puzzle.instruction: Continue both changes around the fixed centre token.
puzzle.explanation: The solid centre token is the fixed anchor. In every step, the other token moves 3 perimeter slots clockwise and keeps the same fill. Applying both visible changes once more gives the highlighted scene; each other option follows a different step or fill rule that fails one of the shown transitions.

puzzle.instruction: Each token follows its own rule. Which board comes next?
puzzle.explanation: Read the eight outside slots as one ordered ring and follow each token separately. The circle moves 2 slots counter-clockwise and cycles outline to half to solid. The diamond moves 1 slot clockwise and cycles outline to half to solid. The star moves 1 slot counter-clockwise and keeps its fill. Each of those rules holds across all four shown transitions, so applying all three once more gives the highlighted board. Every wrong option keeps two tokens right and steps the third by a rule that fails a transition the row already shows.
